value.rationale: The second angular harmonic is intrinsic to the cubic system’s sinusoidal twofold angular velocity. Its complete stationary power spectrum tracks the exact redistribution over arbitrarily many harmonics at the natural saddle-node-on-circle boundary, while the period tends to infinity and raw variance vanishes. The nondegenerate exponential continuum weak limit of normalized frequencies is quantitative dynamical information not implied by period or cycle multiplicity. The restricted observable and physical-time stationary setup are explicitly motivated.
